::: {#exr-train-on-errors}

#### Fitting by following the error rate

Among the 0s and 1s,
plot the [error rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-error-rate) of the 0-or-1 rule against its cutoff $c$,
for every $c$ from 0 to 16 in steps of 0.01.
Could [gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#the-algorithm) find the best cutoff
by following this curve's slope?

:::
